definitions.gloss: to repeat; to reiterate; to do over and over
definitions.explanation: To perform the same action again and again in a systematic or deliberate way. More formal than 繰り返す and often implies purposeful repetition for learning or practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反復|はんぷく}する。
⟦{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}→反復練習：22063_hanpukurenshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To acquire skills through repeated practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{反復|はんぷく}して⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This task needs to be carried out repeatedly.

notes:
To do the same thing again and again in a systematic or deliberate way. More formal than ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ and often implies purposeful repetition for learning or practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}→反復練習：22063_hanpukurenshuu⟧: repeated practice, drill
- ⟦{反復|はんぷく}→反復：11096_hanpuku⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧: repetitive learning
- ⟦{反復|はんぷく}→反復：11096_hanpuku⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: repetitive work
- {反復|はんぷく}して⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out repeatedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat — the everyday word for repetition; much more common in conversation
- ⟦{反復|はんぷく}→反復：11096_hanpuku⟧: more formal and written; emphasizes systematic, deliberate repetition
- ⟦{再|ふたた}び→再び：03600_futatabi⟧: again — simply means once more, without the "over and over" nuance
